command: npx vitest run tests/unit/ops/serwerek-scripts.test.ts --testNamePattern='does not migrate or activate when the pre-deploy database dump fails|does not activate the app after a migration failure|a failing "compose up" of the app rolls back|automatically rolls back the admin image' --reporter=json

cases.preDeployDatabaseDumpFailure: FAIL closed: removes partial dump, preserves current app, does not migrate or activate
cases.migrationFailure: FAIL closed: preserves current app and does not activate new app
cases.appStartupFailure: automatic app rollback to previous image
cases.adminStartupFailure: automatic panel rollback after verifying retained proof

testAdapter: fake Docker, fake process tools and temporary filesystem; database dump/migration are simulated
conclusion: These negative-path controls are covered in an isolated harness. This does not prove real Docker, database, image or server behavior; K06 remains open.
